description: This file defines various template metaprogramming utilities and type traits within the WPEFramework namespace, including pick, func_traits, enable_if, and detection macros for member and static functions. It is used for compile-time type introspection and SFINAE-based feature detection.

classes.name: pick
classes.description: Template struct to select the type at a given index from a parameter pack.

classes.name: func_traits
classes.description: Template struct to extract function traits such as return type, class type, and argument types from various callable types.

classes.name: sign
classes.description: Template struct to determine if a type is signed.

methods.name: pick
methods.description: Selects the type at a specified index from a variadic template parameter pack.

methods.name: func_traits
methods.description: Extracts traits from function types, including member functions, function pointers, and std::function objects.

methods.name: enable_if
methods.description: Alias for std::enable_if, used for SFINAE.

methods.name: is_same
methods.description: Alias for std::is_same, checks if two types are identical.

methods.name: inherits
methods.description: Alias for std::is_base_of, checks inheritance relationship.

methods.name: same_or_inherits
methods.description: Determines if two types are the same or if one inherits from the other.

methods.name: sign
methods.description: Determines if a type is signed.
